iDEP: Investigating Differentially Expressed Genes

If this site has contributed to your work, please cite our article:

Ge, S.X., Son, E.W. & Yao, R. iDEP: an integrated web application for differential expression and pathway analysis of RNA-Seq data. BMC Bioinformatics 19, 534 (2018). https://doi.org/10.1186/s12859-018-2486-6

Summary

Normalized expression values were analyzed using iDEP v2.5.0. The data was first filtered to remove genes below -1000 in at least 1 sample. The data was not log transformed. Missing values were imputed using geneMedian.

After mapping, there are 16611 unique genes in 24 samples. Of the 16611 genes passed filter, 16077 were converted to Ensembl/STRING gene IDs in our database. The remaining 534 genes were kept in the data using original IDs.

Differential expression analysis was performed using limma with an FDR cutoff of 0.05 and a minimum fold-change threshold of 2.

Selected Comparison: INFECTED-CONTROL

Up-regulated genes: 826

Down-regulated genes: 429
